Benadryl High and Pot
I'm no stranger to abusing Benadryl. I thought it was a good idea to take 6 of those pink pills around night time before going to sleep and also smoke a blunt after.
I took them around 10 PM then after about 10 minutes I smoked a blunt with my 3 friends and waited. I did not realize that smoking pot will increase the effects of Benadryl. About 25 minutes after I smoked, I began to feel really light headed. Everything felt a little slower and duller, my body was heavy and I could feel my heart beat through my whole body. My breathing got shallow and my muscles kind of ached a little and wouldn't stop twitching.
Restless leg syndrome -- that's exactly what I had going on at that point.
I decided to try to sleep it off so I laid down but I couldn't stop shaking. I was cold, usually my hands and feet will be  freezing. I kept forgetting where I was and I saw my BF walk into the room and lay down with me. He tried to cuddle me but I kept moving and twitching so I decided to have sex with him because high amounts of Benadryl and sex go great together. It was amazing and after we were done, I was done peaking so I just felt tired and finally went to sleep.
